scope: CONTROLLED INPUT VARIATION of the original sound initialization: one valid sound.hdr and sound.dat under cohokum/audio of a private retail Lebanon root. Not retail audio, not a Tacview or full-pack claim; generated only from the frozen 7574caa2c enum and descriptor table.
header_format: little-endian int32 count; per record int32 sample_index, int32 data_offset, int32 data_length, int32 name_length (the NUL-terminated name INCLUDING the NUL), then the name bytes; names are `audio\<table name>` exactly as snd_data.c sprintf builds them

records.role: matched, nonzero length 96 (first of two records for this key and name)
records.name: audio\lstrike.pcm

records.role: matched, nonzero length 40, key at or above 2069
records.name: audio\ch46e_windup_ext.pcm

records.role: DUPLICATE key and name, different length 48: the original must keep the FIRST match (96)
records.name: audio\lstrike.pcm

records.role: valid record whose name is in no descriptor: never matched
records.name: audio\fixture-unmatched.pcm

records.role: real name of a descriptor under ANOTHER sample index: the index does not match, so that descriptor stays unmatched
records.name: audio\comanche_windup_ext.pcm

data_bytes_rule: byte i = (i * 7 + 13) & 0xff; size = max(offset + length) = 208, so every offset + length is covered

expected.rule: initialise_application_sound_effects tries file_exist(hdr), file_exist(dat), safe_fopen(hdr), safe_fopen(dat); each succeeds on the first, relative `audio\...` path (the engine has chdir-ed into <root>/cohokum), so four attempts and no retry; the data file is opened but not read

carried_over_from_the_closed_header_abse.note: These are expectations carried from the header-absent measurement, not consequences of the fixture; a difference is a new finding to investigate, never something to tune away.
